title: Outils d'artiste professionnel
oneGoal: Students will explore and safely use professional art tools
decisionPoints: Are students handling tools safely and appropriately?
What tools most inspire their creativity?
How to balance safety with creative exploration?
progression: Foundation lesson - introduces advanced tools with safety focus
realWorldConnection: Understanding that artists use special tools, like how doctors, builders, or chefs have professional tools

title: Mélange des médiums
oneGoal: Students will combine different art materials in single artworks
decisionPoints: Are students experimenting boldly with combinations?
What medium combinations are most successful?
How to encourage experimentation while teaching technique?
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by combining multiple tools and materials
realWorldConnection: Mixing different ingredients in cooking, combining different materials in building projects

title: Techniques de peinture avancées
oneGoal: Students will master advanced painting techniques beyond basic brushwork
decisionPoints: Are students developing controlled technique?
What techniques resonate with individual students?
How to build complexity while maintaining success?
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by focusing specifically on painting sophistication
realWorldConnection: Watching house painters use different techniques, seeing how artists create different effects

title: Sculpture et modelage
oneGoal: Students will create three-dimensional artworks using various sculpting materials
decisionPoints: Are students thinking three-dimensionally?
What sculpting materials work best for them?
How to develop fine motor skills for detailed work?
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by moving from 2D techniques to 3D creation
realWorldConnection: Playing with playdough, building with blocks, shaping sand castles

title: Gravure et impression
oneGoal: Students will create multiple copies of artworks using printmaking techniques
decisionPoints: Do students understand the concept of multiple copies?
Can they create clear, intentional prints?
How to manage the technical aspects safely?
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by introducing reproduction and printmaking concepts
realWorldConnection: Stamps, copying machines, printed books and newspapers

title: Collage sophistiqué
oneGoal: Students will create complex collages using advanced layering and composition
decisionPoints: Are students thinking about visual hierarchy?
How are they making compositional decisions?
What materials inspire most creative combinations?
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by advancing previous collage skills to sophisticated level
realWorldConnection: Magazine layouts, scrapbooks, mood boards, advertising design

title: Art textile
oneGoal: Students will explore fiber arts including weaving, stitching, and fabric manipulation
decisionPoints: Can students manage fine motor demands of textile work?
What textile techniques feel natural to them?
How to connect textile arts to cultural traditions?
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by introducing completely new medium and techniques
realWorldConnection: Clothing construction, quilts, traditional crafts, home decoration

title: Techniques mixtes
oneGoal: Students will combine multiple advanced techniques in single complex artworks
decisionPoints: Are students making intentional technique choices?
How are they planning complex multi-technique works?
What combinations are most effective?
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by synthesizing multiple advanced techniques
realWorldConnection: Professional artists combining many techniques, complex craft projects

title: Style personnel avancé
oneGoal: Students will develop and articulate their own advanced artistic style
decisionPoints: Can students identify their emerging artistic preferences?
How are they making distinctive artistic choices?
What makes each student's advanced work unique?
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by focusing on individual artistic voice development
realWorldConnection: Recognizing that everyone has their own way of creating and expressing

title: Art conceptuel
oneGoal: Students will create artworks that express specific ideas or concepts
decisionPoints: Are students connecting techniques to ideas?
How are they planning conceptual works?
What ideas are most meaningful to them?
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by connecting advanced technique to conceptual thinking
realWorldConnection: Understanding that art can express feelings, ideas, and messages

title: Critique d'art
oneGoal: Students will analyze and critique artworks using advanced vocabulary
decisionPoints: Are students developing critical thinking about art?
Can they articulate sophisticated observations?
How to encourage constructive criticism?
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by adding analytical and critical dimensions
realWorldConnection: Discussing movies, books, music - expressing opinions about creative works

title: Processus créatif
oneGoal: Students will understand and document their own creative process
decisionPoints: Are students aware of their creative decision-making?
How do they solve artistic problems?
What documentation methods work best for them?
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by focusing on metacognitive awareness of creation
realWorldConnection: Understanding how they learn and create in all areas of life

title: Collaboration artistique avancée
oneGoal: Students will collaborate on complex artworks requiring advanced technical skills
decisionPoints: Are students contributing specialized skills to group work?
How are they negotiating artistic decisions?
What collaborative structures work best?
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by applying advanced skills in collaborative context
realWorldConnection: Professional artists working together, family projects requiring different skills

title: Installation artistique
oneGoal: Students will create large-scale installations using advanced techniques
decisionPoints: Are students thinking about spatial relationships?
How do they adapt techniques to larger scale?
What spatial concepts are they grasping?
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by scaling up to installation and environmental work
realWorldConnection: Museum installations, public art, themed room decoration

title: Maîtrise technique
oneGoal: Students will demonstrate mastery of chosen advanced techniques
decisionPoints: What techniques has each student truly mastered?
How can they demonstrate their highest skill level?
What growth can they identify in themselves?
progression: Culminates all learning by showcasing individual technical mastery
realWorldConnection: Showing what they've learned, like performing a piano piece or demonstrating sports skills
